lines.text: A large crowd gathers from town after town, and Jesus tells a parable about a farmer sowing seed.
Path seed is eaten by birds, rocky seed withers without sunlight, thorns choke seed, and good soil yields a hundredfold.
The disciples ask what the parable means, and Jesus says the seed is the word of God.
The devil takes the word from path people, rocky-ground people lack root, thorns choke others, and good-soil people persevere.
Jesus says no one hides a lamp under a basket, and to pay attention to how you listen.
